articles.title: Saudi Arabia vows resilience as Houthi strikes hit Riyadh airport

events.summary: New footage confirms a Houthi strike targeted Riyadh's airport. Saudi Arabia stated it remains resilient following the attack.
events.why: Direct strikes on the capital's commercial airport represent a serious escalation in regional conflict dynamics and civil aviation vulnerability.

articles.title: Maps show how Israel’s ‘Yellow Line’ keeps squeezing Palestinians in Gaza

events.summary: Israel has restricted access to 65 percent of the Gaza Strip, confining 2.1 million residents into the remaining area one year into a ceasefire.
events.why: Confining over two million people into severely reduced territory drastically worsens living conditions and displacement pressures.

articles.title: Photos: Gaza mothers endure endless lines as famine fears persist

events.summary: More than 1.4 million individuals face acute food shortages across Gaza as humanitarian aid volumes fail to cover baseline survival needs.
events.why: Widespread acute malnutrition presents an imminent threat of mass mortality and irreversible long-term health crises.

articles.title: Mourners killed by Kenya police at ex-PM's national farewell not part of violence, BBC finds

events.summary: An investigation by BBC Africa Eye revealed that mourners killed by Kenyan police at a memorial for Raila Odinga were not involved in violence. The findings were based on an analysis of roughly 1,500 videos and images showing victims were far from clashes.
events.why: It provides evidence of unlawful lethal force by state security forces against peaceful citizens, raising accountability issues.

articles.title: What do emergency and governor rule in Pakistan’s Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mean?

events.summary: Pakistan's federal government has assumed control of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province through governor rule, displacing the administration governed by Imran Khan's PTI.
events.why: Imposing federal emergency rule over an opposition-led province substantially alters Pakistan's constitutional balance and domestic political stability.

articles.title: Russia introduces drone classes in public schools

events.summary: Russian public schools have added drone assembly and flight instruction to the mandatory national education curriculum.
events.why: Integrating military-relevant technology into primary education systematically militarizes civilian schooling across an entire nation.

articles.title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says

events.summary: At least 139 people, including children, died after an overcrowded boat carrying 305 individuals capsized off the coast of Djibouti. The vessel was en route to Yemen when the accident occurred near Obock.
events.why: Represents a massive loss of life along a dangerous migration corridor.

articles.title: Countries warn against travel to Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks

events.summary: The United States, Australia, Canada, Japan, South Korea, and New Zealand have issued warnings advising their citizens to avoid travel to Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks.
events.why: Coordinated multi-nation travel warnings disrupt international aviation, commerce, and diplomatic engagement with Saudi Arabia.

articles.title: Clashes reported in Yemen as Houthis advance towards Taiz

events.summary: Heavy fighting broke out between Houthi forces and Yemeni troops as Houthi units advanced toward the strategic city of Taiz.
events.why: Territorial advances near a pivotal urban center threaten to destabilize critical supply routes and prolong conflict in southern Yemen.

articles.title: Riyadh airport attacks another dangerous moment in already tense conflict

events.summary: Houthi attacks targeted Riyadh airport, challenging Saudi Arabia's reputation for domestic stability. Although physical damage is repairable, the strikes escalate tensions in the ongoing regional conflict.
events.why: Strikes on major civilian aviation hubs in Gulf capitals threaten regional security and economic confidence.

articles.title: Giants Brigades lead southern Yemen fightback against the Houthis

events.summary: Yemen's Southern Giants Brigades have positioned themselves as a leading military faction combating Houthi forces.
events.why: Shifts in front-line faction leadership influence the military balance and fragmentation within the Yemeni civil war.

articles.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk

events.summary: Polish police detained a man suspected of planning the assassination of Prime Minister Donald Tusk. Authorities acted on credible intelligence regarding planned attacks against Tusk and Poland's defence minister.
events.why: An assassination plot against a head of government represents a critical national security threat and potential political crisis.

articles.title: Watch: How did Roman Abramovich's advisors help hide his wealth?

events.summary: A BBC Panorama and Bureau of Investigative Journalism report revealed that Deloitte helped Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich hide his assets. The reporting exposes the advisory mechanisms used to conceal wealth.
events.why: Highlights systemic vulnerabilities in professional auditing and regulatory enforcement concerning sanctions and offshore wealth.

articles.title: Buildings swept away as flash floods hit central Nepal

events.summary: A flash flood along the Budhi Gandaki River in central Nepal swept away multiple buildings and bridges. The disaster occurred just two months after earlier catastrophic flooding impacted the country.
events.why: Severe flooding destroys essential regional infrastructure and compounds ongoing recovery crises in vulnerable areas.

articles.title: Poland stabbings driven by online glorification of violence, Tusk says

events.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk linked recent school stabbings to the online glorification of violence. The attacks resulted in one death and multiple injuries.
events.why: Addresses youth violence and emerging digital safety concerns at a national policy level.

articles.title: Pope Leo to have surgery after lump found on lung

events.summary: Pope Leo will undergo surgery after a nodule was discovered on his lung. The 71-year-old pontiff stated that the growth was detected at an early stage.
events.why: The health of the leader of the Catholic Church carries substantial religious and institutional implications worldwide.
